about: PRD §4–§6 table row → spec title substring. Key is the row's first cell, verbatim (markdown included). Every PRD §4–§6 table row needs an entry; every entry's key must still exist as a row and its value must appear in an it()/test() title. Update both sides together — a reworded row or renamed spec fails scripts/prd-rows-gate.mjs (CI job: prd-map; local: pnpm prd-rows).

rows.`lookup_rates`: returns matching rates for a tag
rows.`get_card`: returns a card with its rates and cited term ids
rows.`list_tags`: returns tags honoring limit and total
rows.`resolve_alias`: resolves a merchant alias to its tags
rows.`report_issue`: writes report_issue to the quarantined reports table
rows.`points` and `hkd_per_point` is set: values points with hkd_per_point when supplied
rows.`points` and `hkd_per_point` is absent: flags points_value when hkd_per_point is absent
rows.Cap term, month-to-date **absent**: flags cap_remaining when month-to-date is absent
rows.Cap term, month-to-date **present**: clamps to the remaining cap when month-to-date is present
rows.`min_spend`, `per_transaction`, amount *: flags min_spend_unmet when amount is below the per-transaction threshold
rows.`min_spend`, `per_transaction`, amount m: clears per-transaction min_spend when the amount meets the threshold
rows.`min_spend`, cumulative, `month_to_date_: surfaces cumulative min_spend when month_to_date_spend_hkd is absent
rows.`min_spend`, cumulative, spend + amount: flags min_spend_unmet when cumulative spend stays below the threshold
clears cumulative min_spend when month_to_date + amount meets the threshold
rows.`merchant_list`, `merchant` **absent**: surfaces merchant_list when merchant is not supplied
rows.`merchant_list`, `merchant` hits a white: clears merchant_list when merchant matches a whitelist member
rows.`merchant_list`, `merchant` misses all m: keeps merchant_list unknown when no member matches
rows.`fx_fee`, `currency` explicit `HKD`: clears fx_fee on an explicit HKD currency
rows.`fx_fee`, `currency` absent or non-HKD: keeps fx_fee unknown when currency is absent
rows.Any other kind not settled: in unknown_exclusions until the caller settles it
rows.Term outside its effective window at `as: filters terms outside their effective window by as_of
rows.Exclusion key **not** in `checked_exclus: lists unchecked exclusions and hides checked ones
rows.Exclusion key **in** `checked_exclusions: clears cap and exclusion terms by <kind>:<term id>
rows.`unchecked`: lists every cited term with its settle key and status
rows.`caller_settled`: marks caller-asserted terms caller_settled by either settle token
rows.No rates match: returns an empty page with unknown_tag_id for an unknown tag
rows.Unknown input key on any tool: errors on a mistyped lookup_rates key instead of dumping the catalog
rows.`lookup_rates` with no `tag_id` / `card_: rejects a filter-less lookup_rates call with missing_filter
rows.Unknown card or term id: returns not_found for an unknown id
rows.Unknown tag on lookup: returns an empty page with unknown_tag_id for an unknown tag
rows.Unknown tag ids on score: flags unknown tag_ids on score_candidates while scoring the rest
rows.Alias matches nothing: returns an empty matches array when nothing hits
rows.`limit` above 100: clamps limit above 100 and echoes limit_requested
rows.Score with no tag and no usable alias: rejects a spend with no tags or usable alias as missing_spend
rows.Score with a `merchant` and no usable ta: clarifies an unmapped merchant instead of generic missing_spend
rows.Score with both or neither of `amount_hk: requires exactly one of amount_hkd and amount
rows.Score `currency` that is not three lette: rejects a currency that is not three letters
rows.Score non-HKD `amount` without `hkd_per_: rejects a non-HKD amount without hkd_per_foreign_unit
rows.Cap or exclusion the caller did not sett: lists unchecked exclusions and hides checked ones
rows.Report accepted: writes report_issue to the quarantined reports table
rows.Report missing target, `field`, or `clai: rejects a report missing target, field, or claimed_value
rows.Report with a non-http(s) `evidence_url`: rejects a report with a non-http(s) or overlong evidence_url
rows.Report queue over 500 in 24 h: rejects new reports once the daily intake cap is hit
rows.Per-IP budget exceeded (any surface): 429s /mcp past the per-IP budget before the tool runs
rows.Admin API non-GET from a cross-site call: rejects cross-site POSTs via fetch metadata or Origin
